extName.message: PaperCard — Tweet & Reddit Post to Image

extDescription.message: Turn social media posts, or any text you select, into clean image cards. One click, copied to your clipboard. No watermark.

commandCreateCard.message: Copy the selected text or the post under the cursor as an image

unsupportedPage.message: PaperCard can't run on this page (browser pages, Web Store and PDFs are off-limits).

toastCopied.message: Copied! Paste anywhere with Ctrl/Cmd + V

toastCopyFailed.message: Couldn't copy automatically. Download the PNG instead.

toastFailed.message: Couldn't create the image. Please try again.

toastNoPost.message: Couldn't find this post. Right-click directly on the post and retry.

toastSelectText.message: Select some text first, then try again.

optionsTagline.message: Turn anything you read into a card worth sharing.

stepPostBody.message: Right-click a post and choose “Copy post as image”. On X and Reddit, it's also in the Share menu as “Copy as image”.

stepSelectionBody.message: Select text, right-click, then choose “Copy selection as image”.

stepShortcutBody.message: Select text or hover a post, then press

stepPasteNote.message: The image goes straight to your clipboard. Paste it anywhere with Ctrl/Cmd + V.

optionsFooterHint.message: Pick what shows under the post. Stats only appear when the post has them.

optionsQrHint.message: Adds a QR code that opens the original post.

sampleXBody.message: Read slowly. Keep what moves you. Share it so it can move someone else, too.

sampleRedditTitle.message: What's a sentence you still think about years later?

sampleRedditBody.message: My grandmother wrote “Be kind to your future self” inside every book she gave me. I still hear it.

sampleQuoteBody.message: Good writing is clear thinking made visible. Say the thing, then stop.

toastShortcutHint.message: Select some text, or hover over a post, then press the shortcut.

optionsBrandingHint.message: Adds a small “Made with PaperCard” to the footer. Off by default — thanks if you turn it on.

optionsSizeHint.message: Auto fits the post. Fixed sizes suit feeds that crop images (Instagram, Xiaohongshu, stories).

optionsPlatformIconHint.message: Shows a small logo of X, Reddit, Weibo and more next to the author. When off, the site's domain goes in the footer instead.
